_comment: Pre-registered datasets shown in the app so a fresh clone has something to run immediately. The Remove button in the UI does NOT edit this file -- it records the id in the gitignored data/.hidden_datasets.json instead. Restore with: python -m bioradar.webapp --restore-datasets

datasets.name: Indian coastal survey (SIMULATED demonstration data)
datasets.note: SIMULATED. Reads are generated from real COI reference sequences in data/reference_coi_india/, so classifications are genuine; which species occur where is invented. Ground truth in data/demo_survey/truth.json. Do not present as field data.
datasets.expect: 12 samples, 6 sites x 2 rounds. Invasive species increasing 1.9x between rounds; olive ridley and green turtle at protected sites. ~3 min.
